/**
   * Notify that asynchronous signature verification has been started for the
   * given message. A matching signedStatus() call will follow once the
   * verification completes. This lets consumers know how many signedStatus()
   * callbacks to expect, so they can tell when S/MIME processing is complete.
   *
   * @param nestingLevel - The crypto nesting level of the signed part.
   * @param msgNeckoURL - URL being processed.
   */
  void signatureProcessingStarted(in long nestingLevel,
                                  in AUTF8String msgNeckoURL);
